text: You built your fucking DM funnel in 2015, right?
style: Cheeky and mocking, quick, like a best friend about to roast you, a little smile on 'twenty fifteen'.

text: Bro, it works. I post, link in bio, they ask how much, I tell them, and...
style: Relaxed and confident at first, a casual American guy lounging on a rooftop, then slowing down and trailing off on 'and', realizing it mid-sentence.

text: They didn't say no. They disappeared into the inbox void.
style: Suddenly dead serious, low and slow, like a documentary narrator, a beat before 'into the inbox void'.

text: Nah, they're just thinking about it.
style: Defensive and dismissive, waving it off.

text: Thinking for two weeks? That's not a lead, that's a missing person.
style: Incredulous, then dry and deadpan on the last words, savoring 'missing person'.

text: I follow up, okay? When I remember.
style: Annoyed and a bit guilty, the second sentence quieter, mumbled.

text: Three days later, at midnight, hey, you up? Like a drunk ex.
style: A mocking roast: imitate a sleepy late-night text on 'hey, you up?', then slow and smug on 'like a drunk ex'.

text: If I chase them, I look desperate.
style: Frustrated and honest, venting to a friend.

text: They slid into your DMs first. That's not chasing, that's answering. Plug me into ManyChat.
style: Calm and matter-of-fact, then smooth and confident on the offer, a sly little smile.

text: And you'd say what, link in bio?
I answer the real question, in your voice, one question at a time. The right ones get your calendar.
style: Confident and easy, listing it calmly, a short beat before the last sentence.

text: Up to three follow-ups, inside twenty-four hours, and sober.
style: Smooth and confident, then a dry little jab on the last word 'sober'.

text: Okay, that's 2026. How do I set you up?
style: Impressed despite himself, a small laugh on 'that's twenty twenty-six', then curious.

text: First, stop rewatching your own fucking reel. The sunset's right there.
style: Mocking, laughing at him, slow and smug, a beat before 'the sunset's right there'.

text: Comment SETTY and I'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
style: Smooth and smug, then warm and generous on the offer, like handing over a gift.
